optimization.assumptions: Reactive integer model; exact Phase 4 moving-average holding. Same synthetic expedited routes. No terminal salvage credit, extra service floors or invented future demand.

limitations: Unit fill rate is fulfilled units / demand, not OTIF or stockout probability. Lower disruption cost may reflect less production, not savings. Revenue exposure is not lost profit. Terminal inventory and outstanding commitments affect comparisons. Aggregate service may hide product/warehouse shortages. Solver conclusions apply only to configured actions, horizon and assumptions. Firm receipts are preserved. No future demand is invented.

model.inbound_lead_time_rule: supplier_offers lead time is total release-to-factory receipt; supplier transportation lead time is descriptive and must not be added again
model.safety_stock_rule: target included in on_hand; never added to inventory; may be consumed
model.open_order_rule: pre-horizon firm orders; assumed to arrive as scheduled; future disruptions must explicitly state whether these orders are affected

warnings: Aggregate fill rate can hide product and warehouse failures.
No demand is assumed beyond the calendar. Outstanding orders may arrive afterward.
Supplier capacities are independent per component, not a shared supplier-wide pool.

optimization.feasibility: Not guaranteed: a solver must check the requested target.
optimization.scale: Large inputs can exceed local memory or solver time; upload limits are security limits, not performance promises.
